headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 23 studies yielded an effect size of 0.92 (95% CI: 0.85–1.0), indicating no statistically significant association between Vitamin E and prostate cancer. These findings were accompanied by very high heterogeneity (I² = 76.67%), reflecting highly inconsistent results across studies.
